original_target.title: Simultaneously recover sound speed and initial pressure

scope_comparison: Kian–Uhlmann Theorem2.1 requires local speed ordering on prescribed pieces and Corollary2.1 requires global ordering. Numerical learning with unknown speeds and multiple illuminations are not unconditional joint uniqueness from one unknown arbitrary smooth real initial pressure. Nontrapping alone does not imply the stated monotonicity.
